signingLimitations: Current CLI decrypts six keystores in one trusted local process; it is not multi-party remote or hardware-wallet signing.
The caller is not one of the six deployment signers, but needs a separately controlled signing path and native gas for later queue/execute.
No private keys, mnemonics, keystore data, passwords, or signed raw transactions belong in this public packet.

feeBudgetProposal.transactionFeeModel: Legacy type 0 gasPrice; CLI max-fee-wei caps eth_gasPrice, not an EIP-1559 type-2 maxFeePerGas.

TV4 provides nine distinct public accounts and confirms six signer custodians/exclusive campaign use/secure local signing path
TV2 checks public account-map consistency and coordinates packet sign-off without presumed signer custody
